{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for missing values in flipper_length_mm
print('\nMissing values in flipper_length_mm:', df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print('\nNumber of duplicate rows:', df.duplicated().sum())

# Check the unique species
print('\nUnique species:', df['species'].unique())

# Check the distribution of species
print('\nSpecies distribution:\n', df['species'].value_counts())"}
